# pangolin_label_attachment (Resource)

Attaches a label to a site, resource, private resource or machine client. There is no update: changing any attribute replaces the attachment. Requires Pangolin 1.25 or later. Import using the format `<org_id>:<label_id>:<site|resource|private_resource|client>:<id>`, e.g. `terraform import pangolin_label_attachment.example acme:3:site:12`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pangolin_label_attachment" "site" {
  org_id   = pangolin_organization.example.org_id
  label_id = pangolin_label.production.label_id
  site_id  = pangolin_site.example.site_id
}

resource "pangolin_label_attachment" "resource" {
  org_id      = pangolin_organization.example.org_id
  label_id    = pangolin_label.production.label_id
  resource_id = pangolin_resource.example.resource_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `label_id` (Number) Label to attach.
- `org_id` (String) Organization the label belongs to.

### Optional

- `client_id` (Number) Machine client to attach the label to. Exactly one of site_id, resource_id, private_resource_id and client_id must be set.
- `private_resource_id` (Number) Private resource to attach the label to. Exactly one of site_id, resource_id, private_resource_id and client_id must be set.
- `resource_id` (Number) Resource to attach the label to. Exactly one of site_id, resource_id, private_resource_id and client_id must be set.
- `site_id` (Number) Site to attach the label to. Exactly one of site_id, resource_id, private_resource_id and client_id must be set.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <org_id>:<label_id>:<site|resource|private_resource|client>:<id>
terraform import pangolin_label_attachment.site acme:3:site:12
```
